From: Liam Cole <liam.cole@nexamed.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary retain request & evidence for backup purge exemption

Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking this — we're in the middle of a regulatory review and need a short, formal temporary retain on a small set of backups and KV logs while our auditors validate deletion artifacts. Specifically:

- Affected tenant: NexaHealth (tenant id: NH-8791)
- Scope: backups (daily snapshots 2026-07-01 through 2026-08-15) and associated KV logs for the same date range
- Requested retention: +14 days beyond scheduled purge (so purge moves from 2026-09-22 -> 2026-10-06)
- Required evidence: per our auditor checklist we need a signed deletion manifest (listing affected objects), storage-level checksums, and a short forensic note describing inability to fully verify deletions without the additional window.

Can Redwood provide the manifest and checksums, and confirm an escape hatch if a rollback is required? Also we need a brief DPA addendum or approval email that our procurement/corp-sec team can file.

We'd like confirmation by end of week (Friday) to coordinate internal auditors. Happy to hop on a short call if easier.

—Liam
Liam Cole
Head of IT Compliance, NexaHealth
liam.cole@nexamed.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: auditor_checklist.pdf (referenced for requested evidence)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary retain request & evidence for backup purge exemption

Liam —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: we can accommodate a 14-day temporary retain on the specified snapshots and KV logs, and we can produce the manifest + checksums and a short note for auditors. A couple of operational clarifications needed from your side before we lock timelines:

1) Can you confirm the exact set of snapshot ids (if you have them) or give us the S3 prefix/container path? That reduces scope and risk.
2) Do you require immutable copies (WORM) or is a suspend-delete + monitor approach acceptable? Our standard temporary retain is suspend-delete with logging retained and a manual purge trigger at the end of the window.
3) For the DPA addendum: is a simple e-mail approval from NexaHealth legal acceptable, or do you prefer a signed DocuSign addendum?

Operational plan I'm proposing internally:
- Aditya: create evidence package (checksums + deletion_manifest.csv) by Thu 2026-09-23 EOD PT
- Vanessa: formal retention-approval email (internal) and request an SLA exception log tag so we record the temporary retain for auditing
- Kimberly: draft a short DPA addendum/approval paragraph we can route to NexaHealth for signature if needed (target Thu 2026-09-23)

We'll treat this as an exception flow in the retention tracker and add a rollback escape hatch (manual restore_cutoff) so we can revert if required. I'll loop in our support on the specific snapshot/container once you confirm.

If that plan works, we will provide the evidence package and a proposed addendum link (DocuSign) and you can sign or confirm via email.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment: summary_of_requested_scope.txt

From: Liam Cole <liam.cole@nexamed.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: NexaHealth Security <security@nexamed.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 14:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary retain request & evidence for backup purge exemption

Vanessa — thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers below:

1) Snapshot references: s3://nexamed-prod/backups/daily/2026-07-01 to s3://nexamed-prod/backups/daily/2026-08-15 (we don't have the UUID list handy; auditors accept prefix scoping)
2) Immutable copies not required — suspend-delete approach is fine.
3) DocuSign preferred, procurement requires a signed addendum.

We appreciate the escape hatch — please include an explicit human-approval step before any final purge after 2026-10-06. Also request the checksums in CSV and the deletion_manifest to include object path, size, checksum (sha256) and deletion intent flag per row.

Happy to do a 30-minute call tomorrow (Thu 09/23) at 10:00 PT if that helps accelerate.

—Liam

-Aditya
